newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's PRD accepted into Socialist International.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's PRD accepted into Socialist International.

text.p: Mexico's Democratic Revolutionary Party (PRD) said on Wednesday it has been accepted as a full member of Socialist International.
The leftist opposition party, which first ran in elections in 1988, has been an observer party for the past seven years, the PRD said in a communique.
All of the Socialist International parties from Latin America voted for accepting the PRD, the communique said.
Mexico's ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) also was seeking membership into the Socialist International during the worldwide group's current meeting in New York.
A secretary at PRI headquarters in Mexico City said the party would have no report on whether it was accepted until its representatives in New York return to Mexico on Thursday.
